description: EMBOSS 6.6.0 fuzztran: translates a nucleotide sequence in the chosen frames (frame 1, 2, 3, -1, -2, -3, F = forward three, R = reverse three, 6 = all; transeq conventions: reverse frame -k is the reverse complement read from its k-th base, dangling bases give X) with an EMBOSS genetic-code table (0 = standard, else the NCBI table number) and searches every translation with a fuzzpro protein pattern (see fuzzpro: letters, x, [ ], { }, repeats, ranges, anchors; exact). Each hit gives the frame, the 1-based protein start / end, the matched residues, the forward-strand nucleotide location (position 0-based, length = 3 per residue) and, for the forward frames, embossStart / embossEnd, the two 1-based numbers the program prints (EMBOSS 6.6.0 prints meaningless numbers for the reverse frames - a defect of its source-feature mapping - which are not reproduced; use position / length). Hits per frame in the order 1, 2, 3, -1, -2, -3, by protein position, then length. Verified against fuzztran 6.6.0 on 760 random DNA / pattern / frame / table cases (all frame selections, tables 0-11, N and lower case; IUPAC codons other than N are resolved by the library's Biopython-style table, EMBOSS's own table differs for 13 codon patterns). Input sequences are read as EMBOSS reads them (A4-3, one shared reader): only letters and '*' are kept; gap characters (- . ~ ?), '#', '+', '_', digits, blanks and every other character are dropped first, and positions, lengths and scores count the cleaned sequence (e.g. needle of AC-GTTAGC.TT* and ACGTTAGCTT: score 58, length 11, as the program).

sequence.description: Nucleotide sequence: A/C/G/T plus IUPAC codes such as N (case-insensitive).

frame.description: Frames to translate (fuzztran -frame): 1 (default), 2, 3, -1, -2, -3, F, R or 6.

table.description: EMBOSS genetic code (fuzztran -table): 0 = standard (default), otherwise an NCBI table number.

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty
Invalid DNA sequence (A/C/G/T and IUPAC codes only)
Pattern cannot be null or empty
frames must be 1, 2, 3, -1, -2, -3, F, R or 6 (fuzztran -frame).
